title: JBS Australia Contributes to Farm Angels' 'Flanno for a Farmer Day'
summary: The JBS Northern team recently took part in Farm Angels' Flanno for a Farmer Day, helping raise funds for farming families and rural communities across Austr..)
body_markdown:
The JBS Northern team recently took part in Farm Angels' Flanno for a Farmer Day, helping raise funds for farming families and rural communities across Australia.


Farm Angels play the vital role of helping farming families through practical assistance, emotional support and financial relief when they need it most


JBS Northern worked with regional food service venues on a steak sale fundraiser, with JBS feedlot and beef processing sites hosting their own fundraising activities.


Collectively the business raised and donated $10,000 to the Farm Angels.
